review_scope.head_note: HEAD advanced externally during review. git diff 7484328bf HEAD contains only docs/r2/evidence/R2_M10_B_HANDOFF.md; reviewed implementation, design and tests remain candidate-equivalent. Initial checkout clean.

H1.verified: The original resolve/open ancestor-symlink escape is repaired. Every source component is opened with O_NOFOLLOW using dir_fd; the root descriptor pins traversal, and a final fstat requires a regular file. Fresh independent deterministic ancestor-swap and root-swap probes both retained original bytes. _assets compares the measured device/inode and digest with the opened master identity, and a fresh copy-versus-hardlink probe distinguishes different objects with identical bytes. Existing symlink and copy-refusal tests are present; the unit measurement tests passed.
H1.remaining: The original private-snapshot requirement remains unimplemented: _measure streams the live inode, does not materialize a private immutable snapshot or verify a stable file generation. A fresh probe read the first 1 MiB of A bytes, overwrote the same inode with 2 MiB of B bytes, and returned the predeclared digest of A*1MiB+B*1MiB. No retained snapshot backs that measured body, and the current file has another digest. Descriptor-relative path safety does not establish immutable-byte custody. _identity also closes the master descriptor before asset measurement; the inode comparison itself is an improvement, not proof of retained snapshot custody.
H1.fix: Complete the already requested verified private snapshot boundary and measure its retained bytes; establish the approved-master object identity from pinned descriptors. Persist mutation-during-read, ancestor-swap and root-swap regressions. The independent race probes do not replace repository tests.

M1.verified: Validly shaped tag alternatives now traverse count, duplicate, charset, length and banned-phrase checks; chapter alternatives traverse ordering, first-zero, title and duration/minimum checks. Inline values have one recognized key and malformed values produce VARIANT_VALUE_MALFORMED when variants.bounds is declared. The new clean/defect fixtures passed.
M1.remaining: Malformed alternatives are silently omitted by _alternatives. The only malformed-value finding lives in optional variants.bounds. A valid published constraint snapshot may omit that rule while retaining blocking title.length and other metadata rules. Then malformed title/description/tag/chapter alternatives PASS without applicable checks. The title case is a new regression, detailed in N1.
M1.fix: Resolve N1 and add profiles with variants.bounds absent or advisory to the malformed-shape regressions; do not test only all_rules_constraints.

M2.verified: The reproduced FIFO hang is repaired: O_NONBLOCK is applied before fstat, nonregular descriptors are closed without reading, and the FIFO unit test completes. Role limits are passed from constraints and bytes exceeding the limit return a deliberately nonmatching sentinel. Unbounded file growth can no longer cause unbounded total bytes hashed.
M2.remaining: The previous requested bounded-worker/deadline and cancellation coverage is absent: asyncio.to_thread still has no worker timeout, and O_NONBLOCK does not make regular-file I/O cancellable. The stated at-most-limit read is also approximate: each read requests 1 MiB before checking size, so actual bytes fetched may exceed the role limit by up to a chunk. This is not the old FIFO exploit, and no new regular-file I/O hang was executed.
M2.fix: Complete the previously requested bounded execution/cancellation gate, preferably through the verified snapshot reader, and use remaining-limit-plus-one sized reads if the byte limit is a read budget. Persist a controlled stalled-reader/cancellation regression.

M3.verified: One incremental decoder sees all chunks and is flushed at EOF. Invalid tails are rejected as text, truncated final multibyte sequences fail, and a valid character split at the old 64-byte prefix is accepted. The persisted test passed. An additional fresh probe split a three-byte Han character across the actual 1 MiB read boundary and correctly obtained text/plain. Magic-byte classification remains separate from UTF-8 validation. Semantic JSON/SRT parsing is not claimed.

M4.verified: Before obtaining container facts, the service compares lineage project, content basis, approved master id/digest, creative profile id/version and policy digest with the verified run/profile. Every mismatching field refuses SubjectStaleError. Six parameterized PG cases recompute the legitimate M8 payload+lineage digest and alter each substantive binding separately. These are source-verified tests; the reported 20-pass PG16 result is user-supplied and was not independently reproduced here. Future append/load paths retain their own binding obligations.

M.title: Skipping unparseable alternatives bypasses blocking metadata rules when variants.bounds is absent
M.status: CONFIRMED by old/new execution against the identical sealed candidate and valid snapshot
M.scenario: Use constraints_data(), which has mandatory safety rules and blocking title.length but no variants.bounds. Seal a title group whose inline value is {"tags":["history"]}. At bc47ac5a6 the exact candidate returns FAIL with title.length/TITLE_EMPTY. At 7484328bf variant_value returns None, _alternatives drops the variant, and check_package returns PASS with no findings. Likewise malformed description {"text":3}, tags {"tags":"bad!"} and negative chapter values all disappear under corresponding declared checks when the optional variant rule is omitted. The repair test helper always declares all rules, masking this valid policy configuration.
M.fix: Make structural value-shape admission independent of optional or advisory variant-count policy, or make each applicable metadata check fail on an unparseable alternative instead of skipping it. Add differential RED cases using a valid snapshot without variants.bounds, and an advisory variant rule with blocking metadata checks. Preserve the rule that every alternative is checked like its primary value.
M.design_basis: Design section 3.3 every variant is checked like the primary value; D4 only six safety checks are mandatory, so variants.bounds cannot be assumed present.

L.title: New normalized-path refusal cases pass only because their target file is missing
L.scenario: The test passes assets/./x and assets//x but never creates assets/x. PurePosixPath removes dot and repeated-separator components before the guard examines parts. With assets/x present, both spellings are measured successfully, contrary to what the test name and these cases claim. This does not escape the root; it is a false regression-proof claim.
L.fix: Create the target before testing these cases, then either validate raw path spelling before normalization if canonical spelling is required, or explicitly test normalization acceptance and remove the refusal claim. Keep actual absolute/parent-traversal cases separate.
